一柄曾在维多利亚的工厂内铸造和平的重锤。
“用同样的铁与火，去终结那场战争。”

一面属于坚守之人的盾牌。
“推击、拨挡、压制，主动防御的基础在于对盾的运用。”
一个可以证明身份的便捷小装置。 “欢迎进入模拟战场。”

ATK% += atk; in battle the carrier takes `damage` true damage per second — 无来源 持续 damage, not a 流失 (PRTS 盟约记录 修正 "并非流失", 备注 "造成无来源真实持续环境伤害"): shields and damage-taken modifiers apply, it counts as 受到伤害 (受击回复 SP, the 重装 skill trigger, 信仰搅拌机 S3 counters); can kill the carrier. Every 敌人类我方单位 of the field (炎佑, a partner's too) takes the same tick while a carrier is on the field — once per second however many carriers (PRTS 备注 "全场范围内的所有敌人类我方单位也会获得此装备的…效果").
“经典的工业材料军事化应用案例。”

一台属于不屈之人的弹射器。
“它能让你在各个平台间快速移动，前提是你学会使用它，而不是摔个佩洛啃泥。”
On equip: destroy item; pick `count` random operator(s) currently displayed in the player's shop (调度中心) slots, move them to hand for free; those shop slots become empty.
“有时候成功是需要那么一点点运气……”
维多利亚盟约每25层 / 洛洛的定制品

ATK% += atk. If carrier is a MELEE(ground) operator: on each attack, prob chance to apply 战栗(Tremble: target cannot normal-attack while blocked) for disarmed_duration s. Special effect doubled (prob x2 [ASSUMED]) when carrier also has 蒸汽之心 and is Victoria.

一柄曾在维多利亚的工厂内铸造和平的重锤，如今它的威名更盛。
“用同样的铁与火，去终结那场战争。”

一种曾在萨尔贡的荒漠中救人性命的浓茶。
“别畏惧苦涩，它能让你保持清醒，清醒地活下去。”
一套彰显家族成员身份的正式着装。 “在这里，服装有言语不能说明的意义。”

一个属于精准之人的狙击镜。
“定住身形，盯紧目标，钉死敌人。”
“除了有定位与穿透效用，也可作为诱饵使用。”

一把曾在炎国的江湖上铲除不义的短刀。
“拔刀之前，先想清楚是否值得。拔出刀后，就不可再犹豫。”

一份属于迅捷之人的作战粮。
“它的作用是提供能量，不是满足口腹之欲。”
“锅炉工先生经常看着这个头盔发呆，他在想什么呢？”

一把曾在阿戈尔的漩涡里击碎浪涛的重刃。
“直面那些你必将战胜的目标，证明你比它们更强大。”
RES += magic_resistance (flat); each attack applies 失去特殊能力 (silence: enemy loses its special abilities/talents) to target for `silence` s.

一柄曾在维多利亚的工厂内铸造和平的重锤，如今它的质地更硬。
“用同样的铁与火，去终结那场战争。”

一柄曾在维多利亚的工厂内铸造和平的重锤，如今它的势头更猛。
“用同样的铁与火，去终结那场战争。”

一枚属于突袭之人的手雷。
“就是现在！！！”
一款卡西米尔各大周边商城在售的储蓄罐。 “将你积攒起的幸运传递给喜爱的选手吧。”
“呼叫调度中心，呼叫调度中心，我们已准备好接收指令。”
“你们去救伤员，我来对付这些混蛋！”
“通过触摸有限的极致，我们得以观察无限的边缘。”
First time the carrier takes damage in a battle: gain 隐匿(Camouflage: not targeted by ranged enemies unless blocking) for `duration` s.
“我会让你们记住这份教训，我将让你们永远对暗处怀有恐惧。”
“我会保护好我的队友，我会保护好我自己。”
“别把袋子戳破了，你不会想和这些小家伙亲密接触的。”
一面代表卡西米尔骑士竞技的旗帜。 “看见它仿佛就能听到山呼海啸般的助威声。”

一个曾在拉特兰的夜空里引发大爆炸的桥夹。
“开火，别停下！克里夫，我们三个一定能闯出比这更辉煌的事业！”
ATK% += atk. When dealing ARTS damage: also inflict 灼燃损伤(Burn elemental damage) = damage_scale * that damage.

一柄曾在维多利亚的工厂内铸造和平的重锤，如今它的火焰更旺。
“用同样的铁与火，去终结那场战争。”
“增强了烈性的配方，能让你保持清醒，前提是你能忍受那种奇特的味道。”
“你可以用它来挡住一些攻击，它并不介意。”
“她听懂了你说的那句谢谢，她很高兴能救下你。”
On attack: prob chance to add 1 layer of 麻痹(Paralysis: each layer interrupts one enemy normal attack, max 3 layers).
“它能让目标痛到打滚，使用前一定要确认好风向。”
On attack: prob chance to apply 寒冷(Cold: ASPD -30; cold again while cold -> Frozen) for `cold` s.

"一块曾在谢拉格的山峰上见证日月升落的不融冰。
“让自己冷静下来，如同冰川，不可被撼动，却能摧毁一切。”"
ATK% += atk; carrier's physical and arts damage becomes 弱点伤害(weakness damage): each hit is dealt as whichever of physical/arts yields MORE damage against that target's DEF/RES.
“是的，这台设备能帮上你不小的忙，但要获得胜利，还是得靠你自己。”

On equip: destroy BOTH the item and the target operator; special refresh of refresh_cnt(2) operators of the SAME tier as the target, take choice_cnt(1) free. Multiplayer: at next prep phase send 1 copy of the original operator to the teammate who has the most operators of that operator's bond(s) (tie -> random). Cannot target DIY(自编) operators. Never merges.
“这是一份礼物，你可以让它变成任何你想要的样子。”

Normal: equip onto any normal operator (occupies a slot until next round start), at the start of the next round destroy item and promote the operator to elite(精锐/golden). Golden: on equip, destroy item and promote immediately. On promotion, equipped items return to hand.
“端起酒杯，注意微笑的弧度，我保证你会火得一塌糊涂！不，现在还不够打动人，再去换一套衣服看看。”
生效时原干员销毁，突变细胞与其他装备退回整备区，可再次配发；随后获得一名高一阶的随机初始干员（最高6阶），进入整备区，需要重新部署
maxHP% += max_hp. If carrier also holds 天马之枪 (either quality): regen hp_recovery_per_sec_by_max_hp_ratio * maxHP per second.
ATK% += atk. If carrier also holds 天马之盔: every damage instance additionally deals atk_scale * ATK as TRUE damage [ASSUMED: % of ATK, per blackboard key atk_scale; description says 30% true damage].

ATK% += atk. If carrier has bond Laterano: on each attack, prob chance to fire an extra bullet at 1 enemy in range dealing atk_scale_1 * ATK physical damage; if carrier also holds 拉特兰桥夹 -> atk_scale_2 * ATK.
“拉特兰人从不曾怀疑过铳骑的威严。”

maxHP% += max_hp. If carrier has bond Yan: at battle start ASPD += attack_speed * min(k, max_cnt), k = operators the player acquired during THIS round's prep. If also holding 炎国短刀: each time the player acquires an operator, funds += count (max `max` times per round).
“炎国人相信那些关于天师的上古传说绝非完全出自虚构。”

Drag onto the field during prep: opens a personal bounty choice (choice event hunter_band_1). The chosen bounty adds extra enemies to your next battle; killing them / perfect defence grants funds (see ENEMY_GAIN '...悬赏' effects). Consumed.

Flat damage reduction: each incoming hit reduced by `value` (180/300, min 0 [ASSUMED]). If carrier has bond Aegir: when taking damage, deal atk_scale * ATK arts damage to the source (internal CD lock_duration 0.5 s); if also holding 阿戈尔重刃, one additional hit of atk_scale * ATK arts (same CD).
“属于阿戈尔人的秘密被埋葬在最深的海沟中，但它从未真正死去。”

ASPD += attack_speed_1 (35/55). If carrier has bond Victoria: gains the special effects of every hammer (灼燃/坚固/加速/战栗) currently equipped by ANY of the player's on-field operators (burn 10% of arts dmg, undying 8 s, ASPD +30, 10% tremble 2 s). If it also holds a hammer-series item, that hammer's special effect is doubled (burn 20%, undying 16 s, ASPD +60, tremble prob 20% [ASSUMED doubling targets]).
“维多利亚人用数个时代证明了蒸汽与齿轮中蕴藏着真理。”

RES += magic_resistance. If carrier has bond Kjerag: every `interval` (1 s) each Cold or Frozen enemy inside the carrier's attack range takes atk_scale * ATK arts damage; atk_scale_ex (100%) if carrier also holds 谢拉格不融冰.
“谢拉格人相信冰川最深处的宝石是耶拉冈德的眼泪。”

Initial SP += init_sp (30/50). If carrier has bond Sargon: when its FIRST skill ends, SP += sp (30). If also holding 萨尔贡浓茶: each time the carrier activates a skill, all Sargon operators on field gain addition_sp (3) SP.
“传说萨尔贡人将会在黄沙尽头找到时间回流的刻印。”
“新来的这家伙肯定能帮上忙，不是吗？”
“变形者集群，我们早已见识到了你都能做到些什么……”

respawnTime *= (1 + respawn_time) (-40%/-60%). If carrier has bond Kazimierz: for `duration` (20) s after activating a skill, enemies inside its attack range get ASPD x attack_speed(0.65) and move speed x move_speed(0.65) (i.e. -35%). If also holding 卡西米尔竞技旗: during skill duration ATK% += atk (+100%), and lethal damage does not retreat it; it retreats when the skill ends.
一份为卡西米尔的骑士定下的戒律。 “诚实、坚定、勇敢、不屈。”

spRecoveryPerSec += sp_recovery_per_sec (0.2/0.35). If carrier has bond Siracusa: while Camouflaged, ATK% += atk_per_sec per second (2%/s) up to max_atk (+100%, i.e. 200% ATK); the bonus lasts until the first damage dealt after camouflage ends, or until the carrier leaves the field. If also holding 叙拉古正装: that first hit after losing camouflage additionally deals atk_scale (800%) * ATK true damage.
一枚能让人成为“家族成员”的叙拉古徽章。 “学会陪伴你的家人，真正的，家人。”
